messages:
Alex (sales): quick recap from the call with AcmeHealth — they want a 30-day POC, HIPAA-adjacent, EU data residency. Need runbook + security Q answers + cost estimate. Who owns what?
Priya (solutions): I can own integration + prompt/eval suite. question: do they need a specific latency SLO? they mentioned tight numbers during the call.
Lee (oncall): 99th <200ms single-token is super tight depending on model and quantization. which model are they expecting? batching/seq length matter.
Alex (sales): customer prefers an open-weight like Llama3-commercial. avg seq len ~128, peak ~10 req/s, steady concurrency ~5. cost target is tight — they asked for a ballpark before committing.
Nina (billing): rough hosted estimate for that profile (with batching & prefix cache) ~ $0.32 / 1k tokens. Dedicated reserved pricing can drop to ~ $0.18 / 1k with a 6mo commit. I'll do a full assumptions table.
Jordan (security): security checklist: KMS integration required, SOC2 evidence, VPC peering, and EU residency. Private deployment will satisfy a lot of asks; mark KMS & residency as high priority.
Priya (solutions): for success criteria propose: eval set of 250 real-ish prompts, metrics = ROUGE/F1 + hallucination rate <2%, quality pass/fail. operational: p95 < 120ms for full response, 99th token < 250ms if possible.
Sam (product): recommend we offer an automatic fallback to a smaller low-latency model during spikes so they don't hit timeouts. can we create a routing policy? :thinking_face: 
Lee (oncall): yes — we can route to a 'fast' variant and configure Canary in Redwood Console. need to define routing policy: latency threshold + sustained error-rate trigger. I'll draft the config.
Alex (sales): action items: Priya -> prompt set + eval template; Nina -> detailed cost calc + assumptions; Jordan -> security Q responses + docs links; Lee -> runbook + fallback routing snippet. ETA: EOD Tue. @matt_client can you confirm NDA + EU residency?
matt_client: Confirmed EU residency and KMS requirement. NDA in progress, target POC start Mar 30.
Alex (sales): great — legal will follow up on NDA.
Priya (solutions): sample prompt snippet I'm going to include in eval doc: 
```
system: You are a clinical summarizer.
user: Summarize the following discharge note into 3 bullets, preserve meds and allergies.
```
Priya (solutions): will seed eval with 250 anonymized clinical notes (customer provided) and 30 targeted edge prompts for hallucination checks.
Nina (billing): posted preliminary worksheet in Drive with per-scenario cost and assumptions. hosted: $0.32/1k; dedicated (6mo commit): $0.18/1k. will add tokenization assumptions and batch size.
Jordan (security): attaching SOC2 link + recent pen test URL in questionnaire doc. note: customer asked about air-gapped option if we do Private — need timeline estimate from eng.
Lee (oncall): timeline for Private air-gapped pack: ~6-8 weeks from sign + infra prep. Canary + fallback can be ready in 1 week for POC.
Alex (sales): thanks. i'll update the POC doc and assign the checkboxes. Priya, please drop eval template + prompt sheet in Drive and tag reviewers. Nina, tag finance for approval. Jordan, flag anything that blocks go/no-go.
Sam (product): one more thing — include a regression alert tied to the prompt suite so we can detect quality drops during POC.
Priya (solutions): will add automatic eval runs daily and a pass/fail gate.
Alex (sales): perfect — i'll synthesize and send to the customer. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
